Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 14
, Reason for Mistake: In Step 14, the Planner incorrectly analyzed the Wikipedia page content extracted by the WebSurfer. The WebSurfer explicitly reported the text: "George V (George Frederick Ernest Albert; 3 June 1865 – 20 January 1936)". The Planner, however, stated: "It shows: Died 20 January 1936 (aged 70), confirming the birth year as 1866." This is a calculation error; if someone died in 1936 at the age of 70, they were born in 1866 (1936 - 70 = 1866), but the text explicitly states the birth date as "3 June 1865". The Planner failed to read the explicit birth year provided in the text and instead performed a mathematically incorrect deduction based on the age (70) and death year (1936), leading to the wrong conclusion of 1866. (Note: While 1936-70=1866, George V was actually born in 1865 and was 70 years and 7 months old when he died in Jan 1936, or the age cited on the page might be an approximation or the Planner simply misread/miscalculated. Regardless, the explicit text "3 June 1865" was ignored in favor of an erroneous calculation).
